checks.name: Source: immutable baseline, Report has no storage writer/network/AI/share dependency
Default fixture: exact projection and deeply frozen immutability
Score: zero, 100, fractional precision, missing/type/range/nonfinite rejection
Money: partial/invalid, real zeros, signed difference, safe integer limits and unknown period
Goal: exact PW04 projection, empty/invalid/complete/over-target and rounded active state
Records: established validator including unknown dates, all rows not 20-row view, mixed-invalid and absent arrays
Load: empty, malformed/invalid root and separate getter/read failures
